verdict.rationale: Claude Code supports scheduled/recurring background automation (docs-8, docs-13), long-running tasks kicked off remotely and checked later (docs-10, docs-14, docs-26), reactive triggers via chat/webhooks (docs-11, docs-31), CI integration (docs-36), and a sandboxed Bash tool enabling autonomous execution without per-command approval (docs-50). This spans multiple channels (cloud, mobile, CI, chat) with first-party documentation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of scheduled automation reliability over time, and no community corroboration confirming these background jobs work robustly unattended.
